title: GPT-2

title: GPT-Neo
blurb: Archived EleutherAI code for GPT-2- and GPT-3-style models, MIT-licensed, from the effort that made open GPT reproductions a research project.

title: GPT-J-6B
blurb: EleutherAI's 6B checkpoint, Apache-2.0, trained with the mesh-transformer-jax codebase and widely used before Llama.

title: GPT-NeoX-20B
blurb: EleutherAI's 20B checkpoint, Apache-2.0; the training stack is the separate gpt-neox repo.

title: Pythia
blurb: Apache-2.0 suite of models trained in public so scaling and training dynamics can be compared on the same data order.

title: BLOOM
blurb: BigScience's 176B multilingual model under the BigScience RAIL license, which is open access with use restrictions, not Apache-2.0 or MIT.

title: OPT-66B
blurb: Meta's 2022 Open Pretrained Transformer checkpoint; the model card marks the license as non-commercial.

title: GLM-130B
blurb: Apache-2.0 code repo for the 2022 bilingual 130B model from Tsinghua, published as an ICLR 2023 open bilingual pretrained model.

title: LLaMA paper
blurb: The February 2023 paper for Meta's original LLaMA release, whose weights shipped under a non-commercial research license rather than an OSI license.

title: Llama inference code
blurb: Meta's inference code for Llama models; it is not a grant to ignore the license on the checkpoint you download.

title: Llama 2 7B
blurb: 7B base weights under the Llama 2 Community License, a custom license with a monthly-active-user threshold, not Apache-2.0.

title: Llama 3.1 8B
blurb: 8B base model under the Llama 3.1 Community License.

title: Llama 3.2 1B
blurb: Small Llama 3.2 text model under the Llama 3.2 license, in a size people actually run on a laptop.

title: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct
blurb: 70B instruction model under the Llama 3.3 Community License.

title: Llama 4 Scout
blurb: Multimodal instruct Mixture-of-Experts (17B-16E in the model id) under the Llama 4 license named on the card, not an OSI license.

title: Llama 4 Maverick
blurb: Larger-expert Llama 4 multimodal instruct model (17B-128E in the model id), same Llama 4 license family as Scout.

title: Llama.com
blurb: Meta's Llama site for current docs and license terms; the page is the place to re-read the grant before you ship.

title: Code Llama
blurb: Meta's inference repo for Code Llama; weight terms follow the Llama license on the checkpoint, and the repository's last push was 2024-08-12.

title: Mistral 7B
blurb: Apache-2.0 7B pretrained model whose 2023 release made permissive local weights a default choice rather than a research exception.

title: Mixtral 8x7B
blurb: Apache-2.0 sparse mixture-of-experts model, eight experts with two active per token.

title: Mistral Small 24B Instruct
blurb: Apache-2.0 24B instruct model in the size range a single high-memory GPU can hold.

title: Devstral Small
blurb: Apache-2.0 coding model in Mistral's Small line.

title: Magistral Small
blurb: Apache-2.0 reasoning model in Mistral's Small line.

title: Ministral 8B Instruct
blurb: 8B instruct model under the Mistral Research License (MRL-0.1), not Apache-2.0.

title: Mistral Large 3
blurb: Apache-2.0 multimodal mixture-of-experts instruct model, 675B total and 41B active, with FP8 and NVFP4 checkpoints called out on the card for single-node serving.

title: Qwen
blurb: Apache-2.0 repo for the original Qwen chat and pretrained models from Alibaba Cloud.

title: Qwen2.5
blurb: Official Qwen2.5 repo; the 7B base weights on Hugging Face are Apache-2.0.

title: Qwen2.5-7B
blurb: Apache-2.0 dense base model from the Qwen2.5 generation.

title: Qwen2.5-Coder 32B Instruct
blurb: Apache-2.0 code instruct model that is still a practical local coder.

title: Qwen3-8B
blurb: Apache-2.0 dense model from the Qwen3 generation.

title: Qwen3-235B-A22B
blurb: Apache-2.0 mixture-of-experts Qwen3 model, 235B total with 22B active.

title: Qwen3-Coder 480B-A35B Instruct
blurb: Apache-2.0 code instruct mixture-of-experts model, 480B total with 35B active.

title: Qwen3.5-27B

title: Qwen3.6-27B
blurb: Apache-2.0 vision-language model in the Qwen3.6 line.

title: Qwen3.8

title: Qwen3.8-27B
blurb: Apache-2.0 27B checkpoint; the project news log dates these weights to 2026-08-14.

title: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B
blurb: The large Qwen3.8 checkpoint under the license named qwen3.8-max on the card, which is separate from the Apache-2.0 grant on the 27B weights; the project news log dates it to 2026-08-12.

title: Gemma library

title: Gemma 7B

title: Gemma 2 9B
blurb: Gemma 2 9B base model under the Gemma license.

title: Gemma 3 27B IT

title: Gemma 3n E4B

title: DeepSeek-V3

title: DeepSeek-R1
blurb: MIT-licensed reasoning-model release trained with large-scale reinforcement learning; the paper is arXiv:2501.12948.

title: DeepSeek-V3.2
blurb: MIT-licensed DeepSeek-V3.2 weights on Hugging Face.

title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro

title: DeepSeek-Coder-V2

title: DeepSeek-Math
blurb: MIT-licensed math models and the accompanying training code.

title: Phi-2
blurb: MIT-licensed small model from Microsoft's Phi line.

title: Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct
blurb: MIT-licensed Phi-3 mini instruct model in the 4k-context variant.

title: Phi-4
blurb: MIT-licensed Phi-4 weights.

title: Phi-4-mini-instruct
blurb: MIT-licensed smaller Phi-4 instruct model.

title: OLMo project

title: OLMo

title: OLMo-7B
blurb: Apache-2.0 original OLMo 7B checkpoint.

title: OLMo 2 7B
blurb: Apache-2.0 OLMo 2 7B checkpoint.

title: OLMo 2 32B
blurb: Apache-2.0 OLMo 2 32B checkpoint.

title: OLMoE-1B-7B
blurb: Apache-2.0 open mixture-of-experts model, 1B active and 7B total, with the training recipe published alongside the weights.

title: Baichuan 2
blurb: Apache-2.0 code for Baichuan's bilingual models; confirm the weight license on the checkpoint you download.

title: Command A

title: Command R+
blurb: Command R+ weights under CC-BY-NC-4.0; open weights here means non-commercial.

title: Falcon-7B

title: Falcon 3 10B Instruct
blurb: Instruct model under the Falcon LLM license linked from the card, not Apache-2.0.

title: GLM-4
blurb: Apache-2.0 code repository for the GLM-4 series of multilingual multimodal chat models.

title: GLM-4.5
blurb: MIT-licensed GLM-4.5 weights aimed at agent, reasoning, and coding use.

title: GLM-5
blurb: Apache-2.0 repository for GLM-5; its homepage link points at the GLM-5.2 blog post.

title: GLM-5.2
blurb: MIT-licensed GLM-5.2 weights; the card points at a newer GLM-5.3 checkpoint published under a license named glm-5.3, not MIT.

title: gpt-oss
blurb: OpenAI's Apache-2.0 open-weight models, gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b, with weights on Hugging Face and a project site at gpt-oss.com.

title: Granite 3.1 8B Instruct
blurb: IBM Granite instruct model under Apache-2.0.

title: Grok-1

title: Hermes 3 Llama 3.1 8B

title: InternLM

blurb: Apache-2.0 hybrid Transformer-Mamba model; later Jamba cards use other licenses, and this entry is only v0.1.

title: Kimi K2 Instruct
blurb: Moonshot's open-weight K2 instruct model under a modified MIT license.

title: Kimi K2.5
blurb: Open-weight visual and agentic Kimi model under a modified MIT license.

title: Kimi K3

title: LFM2.5 1.2B Instruct

title: Mamba

title: MiniCPM4-8B

title: MiniMax-M1
blurb: Apache-2.0 hybrid-attention reasoning model from MiniMax.

blurb: NVIDIA's 9B open model under the NVIDIA Open Model License, not Apache-2.0.

title: RWKV
blurb: Apache-2.0 linear-time RNN language-model line; the repository is at the RWKV-7 generation.

title: SmolLM2 1.7B Instruct
blurb: Apache-2.0 small instruct model from Hugging Face, sized to run without a datacenter GPU.

title: SmolLM3 3B
blurb: Apache-2.0 3B model with a public training recipe in the SmolLM repository.

blurb: Apache-2.0 minimalist ML framework in Rust, with LLM inference examples in-tree.

title: gemma.cpp

blurb: MIT-licensed Rust inference engine for LLMs.

title: exo

title: GPT4All
blurb: MIT-licensed desktop app for running local LLMs, including commercial use as stated by the project.

title: Jan

title: LM Studio Python SDK

title: BitNet

title: TRL

blurb: DataComp for Language Models baseline corpus, CC-BY-4.0 on the Hub card.

title: Dolma
blurb: Allen Institute pretraining corpus released with OLMo, under ODC-By.

title: FineWeb
blurb: Hugging Face web-text corpus under ODC-By, built to be a cleaner Common-Crawl-derived pretraining set.

title: FineWeb-Edu
blurb: Educational subset of FineWeb, also ODC-By, used heavily for small open models.

title: Infinity-Instruct
blurb: Instruction mixture from BAAI under CC-BY-SA-4.0, which is share-alike and not the same as Apache-2.0.

title: RedPajama-1T
blurb: Together's open reproduction of a LLaMA-style pretraining mix; the Hub API did not return a SPDX id, so read the dataset card before redistributing.

title: SmolTalk
blurb: Supervised-finetune mixture published with the SmolLM line; the Hub API did not return a SPDX id on ingest, so read the card.

title: The Stack v2
blurb: BigCode's code pretraining corpus with per-file license metadata; the dataset license tag is other, not a blanket Apache grant.

title: The Pile
blurb: EleutherAI's pretraining corpus; the Hub license is other, and the original full dump is not something you should assume is still redistributable.

title: Tülu 3 SFT mixture
blurb: Allen Institute supervised-finetune mixture for Tülu 3, under ODC-By.

title: UltraChat 200k
blurb: MIT-licensed multi-turn dialogue set used in many open chat finetunes.

title: UltraFeedback
blurb: MIT-licensed preference dataset used to train reward models and DPO mixes.

title: EleutherAI
blurb: Home of the lab behind GPT-NeoX, Pythia, and the evaluation harness.

title: gpt-oss.com
blurb: Project site linked from the Apache-2.0 gpt-oss model card.

title: Gemma docs
blurb: Google's current Gemma documentation, including the pointer from Gemma 4 cards to the Apache-2.0 grant.

title: Hugging Face LLM course
blurb: Free course that walks from Transformer basics through the Hub, finetuning, and evaluation.

title: LLM course
blurb: Apache-2.0 roadmap and notebooks for learning LLMs, with an emphasis on open models.

title: Qwen3 blog
blurb: Qwen team's blog post introducing the Qwen3 generation.

title: The Illustrated Transformer
blurb: Jay Alammar's visual walkthrough of the Transformer, still the best single explanation of the architecture these models share.

title: SmolLM repo
blurb: Apache-2.0 home for the SmolLM and SmolVLM families, including the training recipes the model cards point at.

title: Awesome-LLM
blurb: Broad CC0 list of LLM papers, training frameworks, and tools; last pushed 2025-07-31, and not limited to open weights.

title: awesome-llm-os
blurb: CC0 list of LLM-as-operating-system projects; a different topic from this catalog, listed so the two are not merged.

title: awesome-deepseek-integration
blurb: DeepSeek's own list of integrations; useful for apps, not a substitute for the model license.

title: open-llms
blurb: Apache-2.0 short list of open LLMs the author marks as available for commercial use; last pushed 2025-02-13, so re-check anything it recommends.

title: Qwen3.8 collection
blurb: Hugging Face collection the Qwen3.8 README points at for the 27B and 2.4T-A95B weights.

title: EleutherAI Discord
blurb: Discord invite for the EleutherAI community.

title: Hugging Face
blurb: Hub, forums, and model cards where open-weight releases are actually posted.

title: r/LocalLLaMA
blurb: The main public forum for running open weights locally; an automated fetch from this ingest was blocked by Reddit, and the subreddit itself is long-standing.
